target: farm stands, egg stands and honor-system produce stands in Honolulu and East Oahu

rows.name: Sun Farm Hawaii (farm produce)
rows.schedule_text: The farm's website lists Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 12 PM as its contact hours. It does not say these are produce-sales hours.
rows.organizer: Marcos and Michele Santos (Sun Farm Hawaii)
rows.description: Family farm in Hawaii Kai growing fruit, vegetables and herbs. A KHON2 report said visitors can stop by the farm to buy locally grown fruit and veggies. The farm also runs garden tours.
rows.source_label: Sun Farm Hawaii website (Our Story / contact info); KHON2 feature on the farm
rows.notes: The address and hours come from the farm's own site. On-farm produce sales come only from an older KHON2 article (khon2.com/local-news/wellness-retreats-yoga-classes-at-sun-farm-hawaii/). Confirm directly that walk-up produce sales are still offered and when. The KHON2 piece also said they sell at local farmers markets.

rows.name: Eggs Hawaii / Ka Lei Eggs
rows.organizer: Eggs Hawaii (Ka Lei Eggs / Hawaiian Maid Eggs)
rows.description: Egg outlet in Kalihi selling Ka Lei eggs from the family's Waiʻanae Valley farm. Eggs are sold by the tray, with a menu of grades and sizes on the wall.
rows.source_label: Onolicious Hawaiʻi (blog); Eggs Hawaii family-farm page; Star-Advertiser via Yahoo News
rows.notes: This is a staffed retail egg shop, not a roadside or honor stand. Hours are not stated in the sources I could use. The Star-Advertiser piece says lines formed in 2025 at a Kalihi shop it calls Island Fresh Eggs, which sells eggs from a Waiʻanae farm; I did not confirm it is the same business. Honolulu Magazine (March 2025 update) says Ka Lei eggs are also sold at Kakaʻako Farmers Market, which is already in your directory.

rows.name: Asagi Hatchery (fresh eggs and produce storefront)
rows.schedule_text: The hatchery's own contact page lists store hours of Monday to Friday 8am-5pm and Saturday 9am-noon.
rows.description: Kalihi chicken hatchery and supply store, in business since 1935. A directory listing says it sells fresh eggs from Peterson Upland Farm and Kaʻu coffee. In 2017 Roots (Kokua Kalihi Valley) set up a small produce storefront inside it.
rows.source_label: Asagi Hatchery website (contact page); Roots Kalihi blog (2017); hawaiianlocal.com directory
rows.notes: Primarily a hatchery and supply store, so it is a stretch as an egg stand. The contact page is undated. Other non-review directories list different hours (for example Mon-Thu 9-3, Fri 9-1). Phone: (808) 845-4522. Per a 2017 Roots post the produce storefront was open Mon-Fri 8am-5pm and Sat 9am-noon; whether it still exists is unconfirmed. Peterson Upland Farm closed in 2024 per Honolulu Magazine, so egg sourcing may have changed.

rows.name: OK Poultry (farm egg sales)
rows.description: Waimānalo egg farm where customers buy eggs directly at the farm. Onolicious says white and brown eggs are sold in various sizes, and that you need to arrive early because they sell out.
rows.notes: Only a third-party blog post, and an older one, supports this. The street address and current hours appear only on Yelp, which I can't use, so they are null. Verify the address, hours and current status with the farm before publishing. Waimānalo is windward and borderline for your Honolulu/East scope.
